commands:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "2f30423766ddd90a8b355c214d040b0117e05be0"
git checkout -B agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
set +e
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayBackendTest > /tmp/chat-relay-red.log 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/chat-relay-red.log
test $RC -ne 0
grep -E 'Unresolved reference|unresolved reference|cannot find symbol' /tmp/chat-relay-red.log >/dev/null
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo chatgpt_relay_red_verified=true
